title: Intergroup Dialogue Facilitator Development & Practicum
department: Words of Engagement Intergroup Dialogue Program
description:
Restriction: Permission of the Counseling, Higher Education, and Special Education department.
Cross-listed with: CPSP300, HONR300.
Credit only granted for: WEID300, CPSP300, HONR300, or EDDI300.
Formerly: WEID300.
Additional information: Students must be given permission to enroll and be admitted to the intergroup dialogue facilitator program. Facilitation is an artform and a science. This course is designed to introduce students to foundational dialogue facilitation skills and social justice frameworks needed to effectively facilitate group interactions across and within social differences. Students will apply the skills learned by facilitating a multi-session dialogue course with either the Common Ground or the Words of Engagement Intergroup Dialogue Program (WeIDP).
